data.title: Jensen Huang Won Over His Wife of 41 Years When He Was Only 17 With 'Do You Want to See My Homework?' and a CEO Promise
data.description: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang won over his future wife with homework, Sunday study dates and a promise to become a CEO by 30.

data.title: Kevin O’Leary Says Nvidia CEO Colette Kress Is ‘Pretty Sharp,’ Chip Demand ‘Insatiable’: Crypto Bettors Weigh Jensen Huang Comeback Odds
data.description: Veteran investor Kevin O’Leary reiterated on Sunday, November 22, that ousted CEO Jensen Huang is unlikely to return to NVIDIA Corp., even as cryptocurrency bettors wagered heavily on the outcome.

data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum Rise, but XRP, Dogecoin Dip Amid Crypto’s Punishing November: Analyst Flags BTC’s ‘Vital Move to the Upside’
data.description: Leading cryptocurrencies trimmed some losses on Sunday, November 22, but sentiment remained downbeat as November turned harsh.

data.title: Dow Futures Jump 1.4% After AI Rout: KOSPI Falls 3.6% as South Korea Prepares Market Rescue Fund, Anthropic Ticks Up on Robinhood
data.description: U.S. futures rose late Sunday, but South Korea's Kospi opened 3% lower Monday as AI worries weighed and Seoul readied a rescue fund.

data.title: Masayoshi Son Wanted to Earn $10,000 a Month Working Just 5 Minutes a Day as a Student: Then He Invented His Way to $3.2 Million
data.description: Masayoshi Son turned five minutes of daily brainstorming into $3.2 million through inventions, helping launch SoftBank.
